title: b₁ is the area under x sin x
caption: b₁ = (1/π)∫ x sin x dx over (−π, π). The curve x sin x is never negative on this interval and the shaded area is 2π, so b₁ = 2π/π = 2.
alt: The graph of y = x sin x from −π to π, an even M-shaped curve touching zero at the ends and the middle, with the area under it shaded and labelled 2π.
description: f(x) = x is odd, so every aₙ = 0.
b₁ = (1/π)∫ x sin x dx from −π to π.
The integrand x sin x is non-negative on (−π, π); its area is [−x cos x + sin x] = 2π.
